title: Origin
appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, Live TV, Trakt, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Sleep timer: The moon button in the player: 15 to 90 minutes or the episode’s end. The film then pauses, your place kept, and the screen goes dark.
Steadier on a busy TV: When the TV runs short of memory, subtitles, previews and pictures now make do instead of closing the app.
Seek previews: A stream that drops while its previews are being made no longer closes the app.
